name: MoYu AoLong 3x3 V5 (Magnetic)
description: The MoYu AoLong 3x3 V5 (Magnetic) brings a carbon fiber core, dual-axis tuning, and a full 48-magnet setup to one of the most approachable price points in MoYu's lineup. It's a competition-ready 3x3 that doesn't ask you to choose between affordability and serious adjustability.
features: Carbon fiber core: Lightweight and rigid. The carbon fiber construction keeps the core structure stable across high-speed solves without adding weight.
64 tuning combinations: 8 spring tension levels × 8 distance settings give you a wide tuning range — from tight and controlled to fast and free-flowing.
Anti-corner-twist design: Outer right-angle geometry on the corners prevents twists even under aggressive, fast turning.
Dragon scale texture: The tactile surface treatment gives consistent grip across the whole cube without feeling rough.
Dual adjustment system: Independent control over tension and distance — two separate axes of adjustment that don't interfere with each other.
8 spring tension levels: Dial in elasticity from snappy and responsive to smooth and gliding.
